supersession_reason: CPG-VAL-020 surfaced that v0_1 acts as a cross-cohort batch detector (every Hannum sample d≥10, median 13.7) because the foundation cohort GSE51057+GSE51032 is EPIC-Italy women 40-65 only. v0_2 expands the hull to include Hannum GSE40279 n=656 healthy whole blood (US Caucasian + Hispanic-Mexican, mixed sex, ages 19-101) on HM450 to widen the transferability range. Phase 1 of multi-cohort hull expansion.
hc_cohort_sources: GSE51057 EPIC-Italy women HC n=177 (HM450, ages 40-65)
GSE51032 EPIC-Italy women HC n=424 (HM450, ages 40-65)
GSE40279 Hannum 2013 US whole blood HC n=656 (HM450, ages 19-101, mixed sex)

hannum_hc_self_test.interpretation: Hannum samples are now part of the hull, so their median d should be modest (self-distances). Sharp drop confirms cohort batch effect resolved.

breast_pre_dx_anchor_v0_2.interpretation: Breast pre-dx case-vs-HC Cohen's d should be preserved (or slightly reduced) after hull expansion. If preserved, the case signal is robust to hull composition.

Re-validate breast pre-dx anchor + AD AIBL discrimination after each expansion

comparison_to_disease_panel_v0_1.note: Mahalanobis not breast-trained. Universal one-number summary across all cards.

route_A_calibration_v0_2.doctrine: Route A threshold is the 95th percentile of pooled-HC Mahalanobis distance, NOT a fixed value. With 112 features, the χ² null expectation for d-squared has median ~112; so d itself has median ~√112 ≈ 10.6. A fixed d ≥ 2.0 threshold (v0_1) is inappropriate for 112-dim data — every sample would always fire. The percentile-based threshold is calibrated to the actual HC distance distribution under the chosen hull.
route_A_calibration_v0_2.v0_1_fixed_threshold_NOTE: The v0_1 'Route A fires at d ≥ 2.0' threshold was inappropriately low for 112-dim data — ALL samples (HC and case alike) had d > 2.0 simply because of dimensionality. v0_2 fixes this with a percentile-of-HC threshold.
